response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and AI-agent infrastructure experience, particularly at re:cinq, with relevant technologies like TypeScript, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and agentic workflows. While his AI/GenAI experience is not explicitly detailed as 8+ years, his technical leadership, cloud exposure, and open-source contributions suggest a capable candidate for a Staff-level role. Some gaps in direct RAG/vector DB experience and LLM optimization may require probing in an interview.
strengths: Proven technical leadership as a Staff Software Engineer at re:cinq, with hands-on contributions to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators.
Diverse full-stack experience across multiple industries, including cloud platforms (AWS) and modern languages (TypeScript, Python-adjacent via DLang).
Strong open-source contributions and mentorship, evidenced by workshops, talks, and projects like GISCollective and Fluent-Asserts.
concerns: Lacks explicit 8+ years of production-grade AI/GenAI experience; current role at re:cinq is recent (April 2025–present).
No direct mention of vector databases or RAG architectures in resume, though MCP and agentic workflows are relevant.
Limited visibility into LLM performance metrics or optimization techniques, a preferred qualification.
